defects: Gold states the iff for an arbitrary map φ : N → N' satisfying the hypothesis `IsImmersionAt J J' n φ (f x)` (i.e. universally over all C^n immersions at f x, including an extra manifold N' with its own model J'), whereas the produced statement hard-codes φ to be the specific extended chart map `extChartAt I' (f x)` into the model vector space E' (with the self model), dropping the immersion hypothesis entirely and the extra manifold/model parameters N', J, J'.

Because φ is fixed to a chart rather than left as an arbitrary C^n immersion, the produced statement is at best a special instance/corollary of the gold theorem, not an equivalent formalization of the stated general fact about composition with 'a C^n immersion'.
Loses the generality implied by the informal statement ('its composition with a C^n immersion'), which the gold captures via a universally-quantified φ with an explicit immersion hypothesis.
